column3: NASB adds “again” and renders “safe” as “a safeguard.”
Close to the Greek.
NASB follows the critical text (“the Spirit of God”); it adds “true.”
NASB adds “might” and renders “thinks” as “has a mind.” A full-width colon appears in the NASB text.
Close to the Greek.
NASB follows the critical text (“zeal”); “faultless” is rendered “found blameless.”
NASB renders “esteemed” as “counted.”
NASB adds “More than that” and renders “the excelling” as “the surpassing value of knowing” and “I have lost” as “I have suffered the loss of.”
NASB adds “derived” and “comes,” and renders “faith from Christ” as “faith in Christ.”
Close to the Greek.
NASB follows the critical text (“from the dead”).
NASB follows the critical text; it renders “have been perfected” as “have … become perfect” and “grasp” as “lay hold of.”
NASB follows the critical text (“not”); it adds “yet” and “I do.” A full-width colon appears in the NASB text.
NASB follows the critical text (“for”).
NASB renders “mature” as “perfect” and “reason” as “have this attitude.”
NASB follows the shorter critical text; “to walk” is rendered “keep living.”
NASB renders “Be imitators together of me” as “join in following my example.”
Close to the Greek.
NASB renders “belly” as “appetite.”
NASB renders “heavens” as “heaven” and “awaiting” as “eagerly wait for.”
NASB follows the critical text; it renders “of our humiliation” as “of our humble state” and “the working enabling Him” as “the exertion of the power that He has.”
